text:
Maria: Quick heads up — Kairos (acct K-47) onboarding running into 429s from Osaka/Japan edge. Customer asks for a temporary throughput bump + IP allowlist so their pilot can run. Can CS + eng approve? Details below.
Sam: Can you paste exact IPs and the requested rate window? Are they on Hosted or Dedicated?
Maria: Hosted. IPs: `203.0.113.12`, `203.0.113.45`. They want ~3x throughput for 72h. Current window = 1200 rpm -> requested 3600 rpm. Pilot AB test scheduled 09:00 JST tomorrow.
Lee: Noted. Looping in infra. @deploy-bot could you create a temp allowlist task for jp-edge and a throughput override?
deploy-bot: INF ticket created: INF-4021. Workflow: allowlist -> route -> throughput-override. Target rollout: ~15m. Ops runbook attached.
Jordan: I'll stand up a canary monitor and add fallback to eu-edge if latency > 500ms. Also will watch for 5xx/429 spikes. What's their SLA tier?
Maria: PLG/Standard. Renewal in ~9 months — they're sensitive to latency and this pilot feeds that decision.
Sam: If we increase throughput, kv/prefix caching should reduce per-token cost. Suggest config snippet:
```
rate_window: 3600
scope: customer:K-47
duration: 72h
route: jp-edge-primary, eu-edge-fallback
```
Lee: Pushed policy to staging and smoke-tested routing. Noting cost exposure during window. @Maria please confirm customer approved cost delta.
Maria: Confirmed with Kairos PM. They accept temporary higher spend for pilot. Also collecting model-output feedback from their SRE.
Jordan: I'll add a dashboard in Console (per-route token spend + 429 rate + p95 latency) and hook alerting to #eng-oncall.
Maria: Great — once infra signals green we'll flip the switch. Plan to recap in CRM and close ticket after 72h with metrics.
Sam: I'll follow up with a quantization/embedding guidance doc for them — might lower spend long-term.
Lee: Rollout scheduled, will post final rollout ts here. :thumbsup:
Maria: Thanks all. Ping me if we need to revert early.
